mapper.insert: INSERT INTO document_files (id, object_id, title, created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by, deleted) VALUES (#{id}, #{objectId}, #{title}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, NULL, NULL, false)
mapper.select: SELECT id, object_id, title FROM document_files WHERE id = #{id} AND NOT deleted
mapper.update: UPDATE document_files SET deleted = true, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by = NULL WHERE id = #{id} AND NOT deleted
